title: Manage automount points on macOS
summary: Use the automount command to refresh, configure, or unmount automatic mount points defined in the system configuration.

steps.explain: Run automount to flush the cache and re-read the /etc/auto_master file, triggering on-demand mounting for any new or changed entries.
steps.expect: Verbose output showing the mount points being processed.

steps.explain: Optionally, set the timeout for automatic unmounting after inactivity (in seconds).
steps.expect: The command completes without error, applying the new timeout.

alternatives.explain: Unmount all directories previously mounted by automount.

rollback.explain: To undo changes or clear current automounts, unmount everything managed by automount.

warnings: Modifying automount settings affects system-wide mount points. Ensure you understand the changes in /etc/auto_master before running.
Incorrect configuration can prevent access to network shares or specific directories.
